entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Libor Vondráček is a Czech politician and lawyer. He has been a member of the Chamber of Deputies since October 2025 and the leader of the Svobodní party since October 2019. Previously, he served as a member of the party's republican committee from 2017. Since November 2025, he has been the chairman of the Permanent Commission for the Constitution of the Czech Republic and parliamentary procedures, as well as the vice-chairman of the Constitutional-Legal Committee and the Committee for European Affairs of the Chamber of Deputies.

entities.summary: Libor Vondráček is a Czech politician and lawyer. He has been a member of the Chamber of Deputies since October 2025 and the leader of the Svobodní party since October 2019. Previously, he served as a member of the party's republican committee from 2017. Since November 2025, he has been the chairman of the Permanent Commission for the Constitution of the Czech Republic and parliamentary procedures, as well as the vice-chairman of the Constitutional-Legal Committee and the Committee for European Affairs of the Chamber of Deputies.
